# Public MediaPipe test fixtures

- hands.jpg: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/right_hands.jpg (Google MediaPipe test asset).
- gesture-reference.png: https://developers.google.com/static/mediapipe/images/solutions/gesture-recognizer.png (Google documentation illustration; annotated and not suitable as a positive detection fixture).

Used only in the local development test harness; neither test pages nor these images are included in the production build.
